ComponentSource.description: Canonical identifiers for every AlphaTrader producer and consumer component.
ComponentSource.title: ComponentSource

DataProvenance.description: Explicit vendor lineage, feed regime, and dissemination delay metadata (ADR-005).

delay_seconds.description: Delay in seconds (0 for real-time/sim, None if delayed but unknown).
delay_seconds.title: Delay Seconds

feed_mode.description: Origin regime: SIMULATED (walk), REPLAY (history), or LIVE (market feed).

ingested_at.description: UTC timestamp when the quote was received at the ingestion boundary.
ingested_at.title: Ingested At

is_delayed.description: True if the market quote is subject to an exchange dissemination delay.
is_delayed.title: Is Delayed

DataProvenance.title: DataProvenance

Direction.description: Directional bias of a technical or quantitative trading signal.
Direction.title: Direction

FeedMode.description: Canonical market data feed modes across configuration and payload contracts.
FeedMode.title: FeedMode

MarketRegime.description: Classified market volatility and trend regime for an NSE instrument.
MarketRegime.title: MarketRegime

TechnicalSignal.description: Output of MCP Server 2 (Technical Analyst) and the Analyst Agent.

confidence.description: Deterministic signal confidence score bounded in [0, 1]. Rule-agreement score, not profit probability.
confidence.title: Confidence

config_version.description: Required configuration version string for the active rule set (e.g. '1.0.0'). Required for schema >= 1.2.0.
config_version.title: Config Version

indicators.description: Named indicator values (e.g. ema_9, ema_21, rsi_14, atr_14, vwap).
indicators.title: Indicators

provenance.description: Propagated input data provenance. Required for schema >= 1.2.0.

rules_against.description: List of opposing deterministic rule names that fired against direction.
rules_against.title: Rules Against

rules_fired.description: List of deterministic rule names that fired in agreement with direction.
rules_fired.title: Rules Fired

TechnicalSignal.title: TechnicalSignal

causation_id.description: UUID of the upstream event that directly caused this event.
causation_id.title: Causation Id

correlation_id.description: End-to-end trace correlation ID carried from the originating tick or trigger.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

event_id.description: Globally unique UUIDv4 identifier for idempotency and deduplication.
event_id.title: Event Id

produced_at.description: UTC timestamp when the event was emitted.
produced_at.title: Produced At

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the envelope/payload contract.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

source.description: Canonical AlphaTrader component that produced this event.
